Install & connect

Install BatmanTunnel on both servers. Pair them once; native transports are configured automatically.

  1. Download and extract the complete installation package on both Linux servers.
  2. Run sudo bash install.sh, then sudo batmantunnel.
  3. Choose Setup Iran, enter service mappings, then paste its secret pairing link into Setup Abroad.
  4. Allow the configured peer/carrier traffic. Open the local panel over SSH and enter your admin key. Initial tests take about 3–5 minutes.

18 native transport configurations · TCP/UDP services · 3-hour comparisons · 60-second health checks. Experimental release: local tests passed; real two-server stability still needs validation.
